_comment: Sidecar for side_locations/cabal_settlements/npcs.md. Seven NPCs: six surviving Cabal Wicks (one per settlement) plus Soft-Flame (Wickhollow refugee at Settlement 3). Settlements 7 (Vigilance) and 8 (Honesty) are abandoned — no current NPC entries.
skip_headings: Side Location: The Cabal Settlements — NPCs

locations.name: The Cabal Settlements
locations.description: A chain of seven Wick settlements north of Wickhollow, founded by the Cabal who voted to continue their work knowing they could not complete it. Six survive with one Wick each; Settlements 7 (Vigilance) and 8 (Honesty) are abandoned. The Cabal's strategic failure is the chapter's clearest exhibit of dignified continuation.

locations.name: Settlement 1 (Steadfast)
locations.description: The oldest surviving Cabal settlement. Mistress Steadfast is the Cabal's longest-living member, keeping the lamp her own master lit.

locations.name: Settlement 2 (Brightlight)
locations.description: A quieter settlement; several cottages collapsed. Master Brightlight continues with spare dignity.

locations.name: Settlement 3 (Companionate)
locations.description: The most active of the surviving settlements. Mistress Companionate has allowed a small visiting community to settle here. Two or three Wickhollow refugees now live in the old cottages.

locations.name: Settlement 4 (Constancy)
locations.description: The most isolated surviving settlement. Mistress Constancy has not left in fifty Pours.

locations.name: Settlement 5 (Fortitude)
locations.description: Master Fortitude's settlement. He has spent fifty Pours studying the strategy's failure and written a manuscript available to travelers who ask. Friends by correspondence with Master Beeswax of Wickhollow.

locations.name: Settlement 6 (Patience)
locations.description: An overgrown and quiet settlement. Mistress Patience did not vote — she inherited the lamp from her master.
